title: New results about Q and $Δ$-spaces
summary: A topological space \(X\) is called a \(Q\)-space if every subset of \(X\) is a \(G_δ\)-set, and \(X\) is a \(Δ\)-space if for any decreasing sequence \(\{D_n : n \inω\}\) of subsets of \(X\) with empty intersection there is a decreasing sequence \(\{U_n : n \in ω\}\) of open sets with empty intersection such that \(D_n \subseteq U_n\) for all \(n \inω\).
